title: Console Dog Car Seat Non Slip Portable Center Console Dog Safety Car Seat Booster For Travel Black
body_html: 1、Anti Slip Design: This center console dog seat features two straps on either side that can easily connect to the headrests of the driver and passenger seats. This design prevents the seat from sliding around in the car. 2、Excellent Support: Equipped with a sturdy plastic support board, this small dog safety seat guarantees your pet's security and stability, preventing them from falling or sliding. It includes two sponge pads for added comfort. 3、Adaptable To Different Consoles: The bottom straps of this pet safety seat can connect horizontally or vertically to fit various vehicle model. An elastic bottom strap secures the seat in place, and an adjustable safety strap can connect to your dog's chest or back harness for added security. 4、Suitable For Small Dogs: Measuring 16.5x8.6x8.6 inches, this car dog bed is designed for pets weighing up to 11 pounds and measuring no longer than 11.6 inches from neck to tail. 5、Enhanced Visibility: Like a car seat, this puppy safety seat offers your dog a broader view of the surroundings. It also doubles as a convenient shoulder bag for everyday travel and can be used as a cozy dog bed during picnics or indoor outings.Item Type:Item Type: Pet Car Booster SeatMaterial: ClothSize: Approx. 42 x 22 x 22cm / 16.5 x 8.6 x 8.6inSuitable Pet Size and Weight: Approx. 11.6 inches in length and under 11 lbs/5 kg.1 x Pet Safety Seat2 x Soft PadsBefore purchasing, please measure the size of your dog and center console to ensure they are suitable.
